STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_02741_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_02741_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_02741(
    output reg [7:0] mem_wr_data,
    output reg [7:0] mem_wr_addr,
    output reg mem_wr_en,
    input [7:0] mem_rd_data1,
    output [7:0] mem_rd_addr1,
    input [7:0] mem_rd_data2,
    output [7:0] mem_rd_addr2,
    input reset,
    input clk
);
    parameter n = 8;
    
    reg [7:0] PC;
    reg [7:0] IR;
    reg [7:0] REG [3:0];
    reg [7:0] OPR [1:0];
    
    wire [7:0] REG0, REG1, REG2, REG3;
    wire [7:0] OPR0, OPR1;
    wire [2:0] instr;
    
    assign REG0 = REG[0];
    assign REG1 = REG[1];
    assign REG2 = REG[2];
    assign REG3 = REG[3];
    assign OPR0 = OPR[0];
    assign OPR1 = OPR[1];
    assign instr = IR[7:5];
    
    parameter [2:0]
        st_if  = 3'b000,
        st_id  = 3'b001,
        st_ex  = 3'b010,
        st_me  = 3'b011,
        st_wb  = 3'b100;
    
    reg [2:0] state;
    
    assign mem_rd_addr1 = PC;
    assign mem_rd_addr2 = REG[IR[2:1]];
    
    parameter ir_opcode_hi = 7;
    parameter ir_opcode_lo = 5;
    parameter ir_reg1_hi = 4;
    parameter ir_reg1_lo = 3;
    parameter ir_reg0_hi = 2;
    parameter ir_reg0_lo = 1;
    parameter ir_dst = 0;
    
    wire [2:0] op;
    assign op = IR[ir_opcode_hi:ir_opcode_lo];
    
    parameter [2:0]
        add  = 3'b000,
        addi = 3'b001,
        sub  = 3'b010,
        subi = 3'b011,
        mov  = 3'b100,
        movi = 3'b101,
        beq  = 3'b110,
        blt  = 3'b111;
    
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            state <= st_if;
            PC <= 8'h00;
        end else begin
            case (state)
                st_if: begin
                    IR <= mem_rd_data1;
                    PC <= PC + 1;
                    state <= st_id;
                end
                st_id: begin
                    if (op == add || op == sub || op == beq || op == blt) begin
                        OPR[1] <= REG[IR[4:3]];
                        if (IR[2:1] == 2'b00)
                            OPR[0] <= mem_rd_data2;
                        else
                            OPR[0] <= REG[IR[2:1]];
                    end else if (op == addi || op == subi) begin
                        OPR[1] <= REG[IR[4:3]];
                        OPR[0] <= OPR[0];
                    end else if (op == mov) begin
                        OPR[1] <= OPR[1];
                        if (IR[0]) begin
                            if (IR[2:1] == 2'b00)
                                OPR[0] <= mem_rd_data2;
                            else
                                OPR[0] <= REG[IR[2:1]];
                        end else begin
                            OPR[0] <= REG[IR[4:3]];
                        end
                    end
                    state <= st_ex;
                end
                st_ex: begin
                    case (op)
                        add:  OPR[1] <= OPR[1] + OPR[0];
                        sub:  OPR[1] <= OPR[1] - OPR[0];
                        addi: OPR[1] <= OPR[1] + mem_rd_data1;
                        subi: OPR[1] <= OPR[1] - mem_rd_data1;
                        mov:  OPR[1] <= OPR[0];
                        movi: OPR[1] <= mem_rd_data1;
                        default: ;
                    endcase
                    
                    if (op == addi || op == subi || op == movi) begin
                        PC <= PC + 1;
                    end else if (op == beq) begin
                        if (OPR[1] == OPR[0]) begin
                            if (mem_rd_data1[7])
                                PC <= PC + 1 - ~(mem_rd_data1 - 1);
                            else
                                PC <= PC + 1 + mem_rd_data1;
                        end else begin
                            PC <= PC + 1;
                        end
                    end else if (op == blt) begin
                        if (OPR[1] < OPR[0]) begin
                            if (mem_rd_data1[7])
                                PC <= PC + 1 - ~(mem_rd_data1 - 1);
                            else
                                PC <= PC + 1 + mem_rd_data1;
                        end else begin
                            PC <= PC + 1;
                        end
                    end
                    state <= st_me;
                end
                st_me: begin
                    if (IR[2:0] == 3'b000) begin
                        mem_wr_addr <= REG[0];
                        mem_wr_data <= OPR[1];
                        mem_wr_en <= 1'b1;
                    end
                    state <= st_wb;
                end
                st_wb: begin
                    if (!(IR[2:0] == 3'b000 || IR[7:6] == 2'b11)) begin
                        if (IR[0] == 1'b0)
                            REG[IR[2:1]] <= OPR[1];
                        else
                            REG[IR[4:3]] <= OPR[1];
                    end
                    mem_wr_en <= 1'b0;
                    state <= st_if;
                end
                default: state <= st_if;
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule

Generate the module

InputThe generated Stage 1 specification plus the required top-module name rtlpp_02741.
InstructionImplement the complete synthesizable RTL module from the generated specification.

Protocol summary; the Stage 2 runner creates a fresh prompt.

OutputReconstructed complete RTL module.
Stage 1 output → abstraction gate → fresh Stage 2 input. The intermediate text is generated separately for each model/attempt. It is not a prefilled golden description. Stage 2 receives neither the clean RTL nor the Stage 1 conversation.
